settings.title: Architectural Pattern Discipline
settings.text: Every shirt block is drafted in-house with high, pitched armholes for clean chest lines and unrestricted reach.

settings.title: Unfused Soft Collar Roll
settings.text: We avoid rigid synthetic fusing so collars frame the neck naturally whether buttoned with tailoring or worn open.

settings.title: Permanent Archive Over Trends
settings.text: Core silhouettes stay in production year-round so you can reorder your exact block in seasonal fabrics.

settings.heading: One Garment Category. Perfected Without Noise.
settings.lead: Founded on the conviction that a shirt is the architectural anchor of modern dress, Gridium develops permanent shirting blocks in partnership with family-owned European mills.

settings.heading: Born Between Tailoring & Daily Utility.
settings.text: We started Gridium after years of searching for shirts that bridged formal shirtmaking rigor and relaxed modern proportions. Rather than expanding into dozens of categories, our studio dedicates every pattern revision to tees, polos, Oxfords, linens, and dress shirts.

settings.heading: Single-Origin Yarns & Mother-of-Pearl.
settings.text: Our two-ply poplins are woven by Somelos in northern Portugal; our summer linens carry the Masters of Linen® mark from Belgian flax; and every woven shirt is finished with 3.2mm Australian mother-of-pearl buttons whipped on thermally locked shanks.
